name: codex-project-flow
description: Install and safely upgrade a reusable Codex workflow with current-project isolation, protected project content, raw-message handshakes, and bounded task recovery.

interface.shortDescription: Bootstrap, upgrade, and reconcile a permanent project workflow.
interface.longDescription: Adopts a permanent coordination-only project hub, upgrades only the invoking task's current project, preserves declared project content, and reconciles active user-visible tasks through an upgrade barrier, raw-message handshakes, a zero-task fast path, and bounded compensating successors.
defaultPrompt: Use $bootstrap-project-flow in this saved local project to install the workflow and adopt this task as its permanent hub.
Use $upgrade-project-flow from a task inside the target project to apply a task-aware upgrade with current-project isolation and bounded successor recovery.
